## Window Types (CoCo 3 / Multi-Vue)

`WCREATE /wN -s=<type> xpos ypos xsize ysize forecolor backcolor` - type 0 (32×16 VDG, needs the `VDGINT` module), 1 (40×24 text, 16 colors, 2K), 2 (80×24 text, 16 colors, 4K), 5 (640×192 2-color graphics, 16K), 6 (320×192 4-color, 16K), 7 (640×192 4-color, 32K), 8 (320×192, 16-color - the widest palette of the standard graphics types, a GIME-enhanced mode). Memory figures and column counts are `Live` (NitrOS-9) in `utility-usage.md`'s `wcreate -s=<type>` entry; treat that as the authoritative copy.
